# mistertranslation.com — crawling is allowed everywhere.
# (This file changes nothing about what crawlers may read; with no robots.txt at
# all the default is already "crawl everything". It exists only to advertise the
# sitemap below.)

User-agent: *
Allow: /

# The Bible project. The sitemap is regenerated by build.py on every build. The
# /v/ per-verse stubs are deliberately absent from it because they are noindex +
# canonicalised to their chapter, and listing a noindex URL in a sitemap is a
# reported Search Console error, not a bonus. Do not "helpfully" add them.
#
# No count is stated here on purpose: this file is NOT generated -- it is tracked
# and static -- so any figure written in it rots silently, and nothing reads these
# comments anyway (crawlers parse User-agent/Allow/Sitemap and ignore the rest).
# The live number is the build's own "verse cards: N published to S3" line.
Sitemap: https://mistertranslation.com/sitemap.xml

# /travel/ -- The Librarian Abroad. Since the 3-card hub landed on the home page
# (2026-09-09) this IS linked from mistertranslation.com/, so the line below is no
# longer its only route in; it stays as belt-and-braces.
Sitemap: https://mistertranslation.com/travel/sitemap.xml

# /finance/ -- The Librarian's Ledger. Same as travel: linked from the home page's
# 3-card hub since 2026-09-09, and listed here as well.
Sitemap: https://mistertranslation.com/finance/sitemap.xml

# /health/ -- The Librarian's Regimen (added 2026-09-10). Linked from the home
# page's hub card like the other two, and listed here as well.
Sitemap: https://mistertranslation.com/health/sitemap.xml
